Q: How do I get a replacement access card?
A: Raise a request on the Facilities portal under "Access Card > Replacement"; a temporary card will be issued same-day while the new one is printed.

Q: Who do I contact for a broken chair or desk?
A: Log a maintenance request on the Facilities portal under "Maintenance > Furniture" and a technician will address it within 2 business days.

Q: How do I book a meeting room?
A: Meeting rooms can be booked through the Outlook Room Finder or the Facilities booking app, up to 2 weeks in advance.

Q: How do I request additional office supplies like stationery?
A: Submit a request via the Facilities portal under "Supplies > Stationery Request"; supplies are typically delivered to your desk within 3 business days.

Q: What are the office parking policies?
A: Parking passes are allotted on a first-come basis through the Facilities portal and are valid for 6 months, renewable before expiry.

Q: Who do I report an AC or temperature issue to?
A: Report temperature issues through the Facilities portal under "Maintenance > HVAC" or call the front desk directly for urgent cases.

Q: How do I arrange a desk move or workstation change?
A: Submit a "Workstation Change" request on the Facilities portal at least 5 business days in advance, specifying the reason and preferred location.

Q: What is the process for visitor access?
A: Register your visitor at least 24 hours in advance through the Visitor Management System; they must carry a valid photo ID at the gate.

Q: Is there a cafeteria or pantry on-site, and what are its hours?
A: Yes, the cafeteria operates from 8 AM to 8 PM on weekdays, with the pantry available 24/7 for tea, coffee, and snacks.

Q: How do I report a cleanliness or housekeeping issue?
A: Raise a request under "Housekeeping" on the Facilities portal, or inform the floor housekeeping staff directly for immediate issues.

Q: Can I book a locker for personal belongings?
A: Lockers can be requested through the Facilities portal under "Locker Allocation"; allocation is subject to availability per floor.

Q: What do I do in case of a fire drill or emergency?
A: Follow the evacuation route posted on your floor to the nearest assembly point and await further instructions from the floor warden.
